died.name: Edvard Grieg
died.last_words: Well, if it must be so.

died.name: Vincent R. Capodanno
died.desc: United States Navy Roman Catholic chaplain and Medal of Honor recipient
died.cause: to a wounded Marine before being killed during Operation Swift in the Vietnam War
died.last_words: Stay quiet, Marine. You will be okay. Someone will be here to help you soon. God is with us all this day.

died.name: Hervé Villechaize
died.cause: in a tape where he committed suicide over chronic pain relating to his dwarfism. presumably when he pulled the trigger, the gun did not go off instantly
died.last_words: Well, I just have to do this, and everything will be fine. Kathy, it's not your fault, so don't worry. I love you. OK, I just need to pull this little trigger... Whoa. Well, I guess I just have to wait.

born.name: Francis Octavius Grenfell
born.cause: mortally wounded during World War I, referring to his squadron
born.last_words: Tell them I died happy, loving them all.

born.name: Abdul Hafiz
born.desc: VC, Indian recipient of the Victoria Cross
born.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of Imphal
born.last_words: Reorganise the post, I will give covering fire.
